text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH - serving-degrade eu-west-az3 fired (threshold: 5xx rate > 4% over 2m). PD incident: I-202803-az3. Allocated priority: P1. :rotating_light:

oncall-jordan: Acked. I'm oncall now, looking. Any immediate customer reports?

sre-lee: seeing increased 503s on rt-gateway stacks in az3, packet loss on a subset of NICs. Host level evictions spiking.

oncall-jordan: ok, can you paste the most recent healthcheck summary?

sre-lee: ```
> svc: rt-gateway
> az: eu-west-az3
> 1m 5xx: 5.1% (baseline 0.4%)
> average latency p95: 1.2s -> 3.8s
> node evictions: +18 in last 10m
```

eng-runtime-maya: we've got cache shard errors from prefix-cache that correlate with eviction bursts. Fallback routing kicked in for some customers but not all.

support-ram: support queue: 12 tickets mentioning "model timeouts" and 3 enterprise customers on Dedicated reporting increased error rates. Opening customer-facing bridge note.

oncall-jordan: immediate mitigation plan: 1) scale routing away from az3 to eu-west-az1/az2 (divert traffic) 2) enable fast-fail to smaller model variant for hosted API routes 3) trigger autoscaler for spare capacity in az1. Lee/Maya take action 1 & 2. I'll coordinate comms.

sre-lee: starting routing divert now. Updating route policy: ```/admin/routing divert set region=eu-west exclude=az3 percent=80``` Rolling in 2m.

eng-runtime-maya: enabling fast-fail to model-compact-v2 for affected model groups. Patch applied to rollout policy. Example change: ```
"fallback_policy": {"preferred": ["model-compact-v2"], "threshold": 0.03}
```

incident-bot: Automated update: routing-divert job queued, fallback rollout queued.

support-ram: sending proactive email to 3 impacted enterprise accounts + support notice in status.redwood.ai/incidents (draft ready).

product-alex: flagging SLAs for Dedicated customers — do we have estimated RTO?

oncall-jordan: working on ETA. Early estimate: partial mitigation in 8-12 minutes after routing finishes, full recovery depends on node stabilization.

eng-runtime-maya: Note — some long-tail requests still hit problematic nodes due to sticky session affinity. Reconfiguring affinity TTL to 15s to speed eviction handling.

sre-lee: NIC error logs (snip): ```
[2026-03-15T12:03:21Z] nic0: link flaps detected
[2026-03-15T12:04:02Z] kernel: network rx drops increasing
[2026-03-15T12:05:10Z] kubelet: pod evicted due to OOM/kubelet node pressure
```

incident-bot: PD: Escalation to L2 triggered after 5m no recovery. Notifying oncall-l2.

oncall-jordan: L2 notified. @sre-lee continue node stabilization. @eng-runtime-maya confirm cache shard rehydration plan?

eng-runtime-maya: Starting prefix-cache rehydration on az1/az2, warming with common prefixes. Also throttling write-heavy clients to reduce eviction churn.

support-ram: Live status update posted: "We are mitigating a serving degradation in eu-west-az3. Some requests may see increased errors or be routed to alternate zones. We're working on a fix and will update in 15 minutes."

product-alex: any customer-impact metric to surface to sales? e.g., percentage of requests affected or number of accounts?

oncall-jordan: early metric: ~18% of traffic from eu-west total had at least one retry or 5xx in the window. Affected hosts concentrated to one AZ. We'll include affected customers list once support finishes correlation.

sre-lee: Node drain is in progress for 6 problematic hosts. Running ``kubectl drain`` then running NIC reboot script.

eng-runtime-maya: rollout of fallback model completed for 90% of affected routes. Observing drop in error rate locally.

incident-bot: Automated update: 5xx rate dropped to 1.2% (2m window).

oncall-jordan: good, keep monitoring. Outbound routing still completing (should be done ~+4m). Any manual actions left?

sre-lee: after node reboots, we'll validate kernel NIC firmware; opening a follow-up ticket to track hardware team action. For now nodes will rejoin.

support-ram: Customers notified: 3 enterprise accounts received dedicated email, 12 tickets updated, status page updated. No escalations to legal/finance.

product-alex: sounds like containment succeeded. We'll prepare a post-incident summary draft once stabilized. Please capture timeline & decisions.

oncall-jordan: marking incident as under mitigation (P1 -> active response). Next update in 10m or earlier if changes. If error rate stays <1.5% and routing complete, we'll transition to monitoring and postmortem. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: PD: Incident I-202803-az3 - status: mitigation in progress - responders: oncall-jordan, sre-lee, eng-runtime-maya, support-ram.

sre-lee: final note: we've seen correlation between a recent kernel patch and NIC firmware behavior on a subset of instance types in az3. Will include in postmortem hypothesis.

oncall-jordan: thanks all. I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for updates and will file the postmortem ticket after we confirm recovery.

support-ram: adding convo note: customers asked for explanation; message templates are saved to /kb/incidents/az-network-fallback.

incident-bot: Automated update: last recorded 5xx window: 0.9%. If stable for 15m, auto-close will suggest 'monitoring' state.
